description: A small chibi pixel art head seen from the front, bald, with long pointed ears and big violet eyes. Paint only inside the white of the mask, across the eyes: a pair of round glasses whose two frames are little bright-orange carved pumpkins with dark ribs, each with a tiny green stem on top, joined by a short dark bridge; the lenses are clear, so the eyes show through them. The eyes must stay visible through it. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The rest of the face, the head and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
